title: Cowboys dispute report that Steelers were angered by trade down with Eagles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys dispute report that Steelers were angered by trade down with Eagles
sources.description: The Cowboys rained on Pittsburgh's draft parade on Thursday night, by trading out of the No. 20 spot and allowing the Eagles to draft receiver Makai Lemon at a time when the Steelers had Lemon on the phone.
